findings.problem: Trailing full stops are inconsistent across one-sentence status strings of the same shape: not_checked, idle, available, retry_wait, failed, unknown and other_error carry no 。, while needs_review, missing, conflict, transport_error and the longer status strings end with it. English terminates all of them with a full stop.
findings.fix: Pick one convention for full status sentences (normally 。) and apply it to the seven short strings, or drop it from all of them.
